answer_4.quote: We recruit 8 user study groups U , 5 study participants per group... For each participant u ∈ U_i , we present each t_{j,i} individually sorted alphabetically. We ask participants to cluster words in t_{j,i} that they deem similar to form coherent word groups g... We use Likert matrix as the response format...
answer_4.guideline: Participants were instructed to assign each word to a coherent group (or “Not Related”) using a Likert matrix, clustering words they perceived as semantically coherent.
